author: The Current
description:
Watch Ber play songs from her debut full-length album, 'Good, Like It Should Be'
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

As part of Minnesota Music Month, singer-songwriter Ber — aka Berit Dybing, originally from Bemidji, Minnesota — participated in a live taping of The Local Show recorded in the Forum at Minnesota Public Radio. Ber's debut full-length album, 'Good, Like It Should Be,' released on April 3, 2026, just days before this recording session. On The Local Show, Ber performed solo versions of three songs off the new album before sitting down for a chat with The Local Show host, Diane.

"I moved [to Minneapolis] when I had literally nothing," Ber tells Diane, "and The Current started spinning my tunes, and it's fully the reason why I'm doing this today. ... I very much don't take this for granted."

Watch the full session and interview above.

author: The Current
description:
Watch José González play "ETYD"
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Although the title of José González’s 2026 album, Against the Dying of the Light, is recognizable from the work of Welsh poet Dylan Thomas, Swedish singer-songwriter González was more inspired by modern-day Oxford philosopher Toby Ord and his 2020 book, The Precipice: Existential Risk and the Future of Humanity. “[Ord] talks about natural risks that amount to one in 10,000 that we don't make it next 100 years,” González says, “but then the man-made risks, the estimations are around one in six that we don't make it, and I was like, ‘This is something we should rage against.’"

González admits the core of his music — and what his fans admire — is the softer, more soothing sounds of his music and lyrics.
